summary: Focused verification completed for guest-to-auth draft flow, auth guard backend tests, signup/login return behavior, draft edge-cases, and authenticated submit interception. Fix VoicePicker/DOM instrumentation path causing '<span> inside <option>' hydration warning in console.

critical_code_review_comments: TEST FIX APPLIED: /app/tests/test_guest_policy_auth_guards.py cleanup now deletes captured story IDs and owner-linked stories before deleting users/sessions, preventing orphan fixtures.
TEST FIX APPLIED: anonymous no-insert assertion now uses unique child_name counters instead of TEST_AUTHPOL_ id-prefix counting (more accurate with uuid story IDs).
Frontend Create->Auth behavior is correctly guarded: guest generate click does not post /api/stories before auth step.
Use of sessionStorage draft handling is robust for malformed JSON and >2h expiry (verified).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test JPEG /app/tests/test_valid_photo.jpg and temporary TEST signup accounts for UI auth-flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed: guest form fill + photo + generate opens auth prompt without create POST; signup/login switch preserves next; signup return to /create?resume=1 restores child_name/age/gender/page_count/voice/story language/style/prompt/photo filename+preview; wrong password shows auth error then QA login succeeds; quota failure shows retention error and keeps photo/form; malformed+expired drafts handled. Authenticated submit one-request + draft-clear verified using TEST-ONLY interception (MOCKED network response in test harness only, no production changes). Remaining to retest: explicit 401 on final authenticated submit reopening auth modal with preserved details.
rca of the issue: The frontend hydration warning stems from invalid nested content under <option> seen at runtime (console logs point to VoicePicker option rendering path with debug wrapper span). This does not block core flow but can cause hydration instability and should be cleaned.
